text:
Jake Guentzel has 13 goals and 29 points in 24 games, and he has kept producing while the Lightning live with Nikita Kucherov's trade request. His ice time has climbed by more than a minute a night over his last ten games, to 22 minutes, and he has a four-game point streak.

Some of the scoring will come back to earth. He has 13 goals on 9.9 expected goals (the quality of his chances), shooting 21% against 17% last season, and Tampa has scored 9.6 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey's read from last season adds context: his linemates rank in the 90th percentile, which flatters the on-ice numbers. What's real is where he shoots from. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 81st percentile for chances from the home plate area in front of the net, and that is a skill, not a streak. Our numbers project about 40 goals. Watch how his production holds if the top line changes around him.
headline: Guentzel is finishing above his chances again
